Noah: Quick heads-up: big congrats for @Celia 4aa she closed on a new house this weekend AND just got promoted to Senior PM!! :house_with_garden: :tada:
Celia: ahhh you all 60d thank you!! closed on Saturday, moved a few boxes, and then the promo email landed on Monday morning 389 still pinching myself. picture of the tiny backyard: https://imgur.com/example-house
Tara: omg housewarming + promo celebration? we need balloons and a card :balloon:
Ben: i can DJ the tiny conf room playlist. also happy to ferry boxes if anyone needs moving muscles :muscle:
People-ops-bot: Congrats Celia on your promotion to Senior PM! HR will update your title and send next steps. For relocation/remote work policy questions, please contact people-ops.
Lina: HUGE congrats. very deserved. shall we do a cake + plant (new home, get a plant) tomorrow at 3pm in the kitchen area? i'll bring a snake plant.
Sam: :cake: + :seedling: yes please. what time works for everyone?
Celia: 3pm works. if ppl want to bring a small housewarming snack, pls do not feel obligated. i'm so grateful. also will DM address for those who asked about sending a card.
Noah: calendar invite sent for 3pm, kitchen. react if you can make it so we know cake size :partying_face:
Tara: :cake:
Ben: :thumbsup:
Lina: :heart:
Celia: :smiling_face_with_three_hearts: thank you everyone, see you tomorrow!
